mapper.select: select t1.id AS id, t1.material_code as materialCode, t1.maintence_style AS maintenceStyle, t2.phases as phases, t2.maintain_days as maintainDays, t3.site_name as pidRoute, t2.content as content, t1.principal_ids as principalId from tb_maintain_plan t1 left join tb_maintain_plan_stage t2 on t2.id = t1.stage_id left join tb_stack t3 on t3.id = t1.stack_id where t1.is_end = '1' and ${column} and t1.materialCode like concat('%',#{maintainPlanDto.materialCode},'%') and t1.principal_ids like concat('%',#{maintainPlanDto.principalId},'%') and t1.maintence_style = #{maintainPlanDto.maintenceStyle} and t2.phases = #{maintainPlanDto.phases}

select t1.id AS id, t1.material_code as materialCode, t1.maintence_style AS maintenceStyle, t2.phases as phases, t3.site_name as pidRoute, t2.content as content, t1.principal_ids as principalId from tb_maintain_plan t1 left join tb_maintain_plan_stage t2 on t2.id = t1.stage_id left join tb_stack t3 on t3.id = t1.stack_id where t1.id = #{id}

select t2.id as id, t1.maintence_style as maintenceStyle, t2.phases as phases, t2.maintain_days as maintainDays, t2.created_time as createdTime, t2.updated_time as updatedTime, t2.oxygen_reduction_day as oxygenReductionDay from tb_maintain_plan t1 left join tb_maintain_plan_stage t2 on t1.id = t2.maintain_plan_id where t1.id = #{id} order by t2.id

SELECT MIN(t2.created_time) createdTime,MAX(t2.updated_time) updatedTime, t1.stack_id AS stackId FROM tb_maintain_plan t1 LEFT JOIN tb_maintain_plan_stage t2 ON t1.id = t2.maintain_plan_id WHERE t1.id= #{id};

select t1.id as id, t1.warning_time as warningTime, t1.warning_type as warningType, t1.warning_val as warningVal, t2.deal_method as dealSuggestion, t2.finish_time as dealTime from (select warning_val,id,warning_type,stack_id,task_id,case when warning_time_one is not null then warning_time_one when (warning_time_one is null and warning_time_two is not null) then warning_time_two else warning_time_three end as warning_time from tb_early_warning where stack_id =#{maintainPlanVo.stackId} and warning_type IN ('04','06','08','10','12','13')) t1 inner join tb_task t2 on t1.task_id = t2.id where warning_time >= #{maintainPlanVo.createdTime} and warning_time <= #{maintainPlanVo.updatedTime}
